Hollis, the ticket is **#88412**. Tobias Rendle posted it in #central-team on July 2, 2025, as the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan at Tansleigh Packaging. I found no later update on it in that channel, so I can't tell whether it's still open. Support would need to confirm that.

Note that #4912 is a different Door 6 issue at the Tansleigh Marietta plant (a phantom lock at the guard shack), so don't use that number for this one.
